name: Rat
source:
An Ancient who came through the portal. Rat followed the protagonist and Oya while they were retreating, severely injuring Gaia when they were attacked.
[spoiler]It is one of the 7 old Ancients and its name is Wrath, the angry werewolf.[/spoiler]
